citation.description: _scc_command always emits --by-file; tests/unit/metrics/test_scc_loc_heldout.py:103-106 asserts the argv contains --by-file

criteria.criterion: The scc invocation includes `--by-file` so file entries are actually returned; proven RED-first with a test that fails on the current argv.

citation.description: Empty `files` dict guard returns _unavailable('scc reported no files'); test_empty_file_list_is_unavailable_not_a_confident_zero in test_scc_loc_heldout.py covers both empty shapes

criteria.criterion: An EMPTY file list is reported as `Unavailable`, never as a zero-valued AnalyzerResult -- a zero must mean 'measured zero', not 'measured nothing'.
